name: Website contacts to CSV — manual capped export

nodes.name: Manual start
nodes.notes: Importing does not run the Actor. Each manual execution starts a new paid snapshot.

nodes.name: Extract contacts — max $0.03
nodes.notes: Required: select a private Header Auth credential: Authorization = Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN. No token is included in this template. Edit websiteUrls in the JSON body. A failed response may still have started a run: check Apify Console before retrying.

nodes.name: Create contacts.csv
nodes.notes: Download binary field data after execution. Empty datasets may produce no file. Formula-like cells receive an apostrophe prefix; retain the JSON if exact original strings are needed.
